title: Isicaka Sobulumko Obufihliweyo
intro: Kwimbali enkulu yamabali eQuran, kumi umntu ongaqondakaliyo, umkhonzi ka-Allah ohlonitshwe lulwazi nenceba kaThixo. Lo mntu ungaqondakaliyo wadibana nomnye wabaprofeti abakhulu, ekhokelela kuhambo oluzele zizenzo ezididayo ezazivavanya imida yokuqonda komntu. Isenzo ngasinye, nangona sibonakala singalunganga, sifihle izifundo ezinzulu malunga nekamva, umonde, kunye nobulumko obungabonakaliyo obungasemva komyalelo kaThixo. Ngubani lo mntu umnyama, kwaye zeziphi iinyaniso abazityhileyo?
clues: Ndandingumkhonzi ka-Allah, ndikhethelwe ulwazi olukhethekileyo nenceba.
Umprofeti omkhulu wafuna ukufunda kum, ndaza ndavuma phantsi kwemiqathango engqongqo.
Ngexesha lentlanganiso yethu, ndenze izinto ezintathu ezazibonakala zingalunganga kumhlobo wam.
Ndonakalise isikhephe sabantu abahlwempuzekileyo, kodwa yayiyinceba efihlakeleyo.
Ndabulala umntwana omncinci, nangona kwakubonakala ngathi kukhohlakele, kodwa kwakungenxa yokuba abazali bakhe babengenalo usizi.
Ndakha udonga kwakhona kwidolophu eyayingasivumeli ukuba singenelwe ziindwendwe, ndatyhila ubutyebi phantsi kwalo.

arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًۭا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًۭا
verse: And they found a servant from among Our servants [i.e., al-Khiḍr] to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge. (18:65)
